subject: Azure Partner Center referral – territory deconflict & referral owner table
messages:
From: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@microsoft.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Jenkins <sean.jenkins@commonenterprise.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Partner Center referral: Common Enterprise - guidance & next steps

Hi Connor,

Quick intro — I'm Sarah on the Azure Partner Center referrals team. We received a referral for Common Enterprise (they expressed interest in an MLOps/inference proof-of-concept tied to regulatory workloads). Sean from Common Enterprise looped me in.

Before we push the referral into Partner Center and route to a Microsoft field seller, we need to:
- Confirm the appropriate Redwood field seller / partner contact to attach (so MS knows who to route to)
- Ensure no overlapping seller ownership for the same tenancy/ERP account (Common Enterprise has multiple business units)
- Attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) or partner contact table so the Azure AE can follow up quickly.

Can you confirm a suggested owner on your side and provide a simple CSV with account/owner rows? If you prefer, list guidance in the body and we can add to the PC referral. Our deadline for the referral window is EOD Tue (Pacific).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Mendez
Partner Center Operations — Microsoft Azure
[Attachment: common-enterprise-referral.pdf (pdf) — brief summary from Common Enterprise]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@microsoft.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Jenkins <sean.jenkins@commonenterprise.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 17:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral: Common Enterprise - guidance & next steps

Thanks Sarah — looping in Lauren (field seller alignment) and Karthik (partner programs) to own the mapping and confirm there isn't overlap.

High level from our side:
- Redwood is happy to accept the referral into Partner Center and work with the Azure AE, but we need the referral to target a single seller contact for initial outreach.
- Common Enterprise has three target BU pilots (Payments, Fraud Ops, and Clinical Compliance). We recommend we route Payments pilot to our East Coast seller, Laura Chen (internal SDR + AE chain), Fraud Ops to LA regional, and Clinical Compliance handled by our regulated-works team.

I'll attach a quick draft CSV (referral-owner-table.csv) and a one-page MAP. Please add the Azure AE in the Partner Center referral when you submit.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: referral-owner-table.csv (csv)]
